alpha_inheritance_cor_rationale: SEFRS는 alpha sleeve X — STR_1715 alpha core 보존 + DPL-RC complement classifier feature pool inject. correlation 측정 대상 X.
mechanism_description: SEFRS v1.0은 KR retail-crowded inverse/leverage ETF 3종 (KODEX 200선물인버스2X = 252670, KODEX 인버스 = 114800, KODEX 레버리지 = 122630)의 일별 설정/환매 (Δ발행주식수 × NAV_{t-k-1}) notional flow를 multiplier-weighted aggregate 후 rolling z-score 60d 표준화하여 KOSPI200 regime sentiment proxy를 생성한다. 핵심 paradigm: (1) 3 ETF complex aggregation — 단일 ETF flow noise 회피 + multiplier (252670=+2, 114800=+1, 122630=-2). (2) PIT-safe — flow = Δshares × NAV_{t-k-1}, k≥2 strict (Forge Stage 1 publish probe empirical 결정). (3) Non-linear regime sensor mandate — 중간 imbalance = risk-off continuation, extreme imbalance = contrarian. KR media articles (KOSPI 8000 + 34조 inverse / 99.9% retail loss)는 motivating empirical context only — predictive validity는 Forge Stage 2~4 OOS AUC + Harvey-Liu-Zhu 다중검정 보정으로만 입증 (Codex C4 PARTIAL). (4) 12 sub-features (1 primary + 8 secondary + 3 interaction) DPL-RC p_bad_1715 classifier feature pool inject (80 → 88) AUC uplift target ≥ 0.01. 학술 backbone: 5 RFS/JF/RAS top-tier peer-reviewed (Brown 2021 + Ben-David 2018 + Israeli 2017 + Pan-Zeng 2017 + Easley 2021). Alpha sleeve X — multi-sleeve framework (1715 alpha core + DPL-RC complement + SEFRS regime feature inject). AX-005/007 회피 claim은 Forge Stage 4 integration result로 입증 의무 (Codex C6 ACCEPT).
